title: qdelaunay
description: Compute the Delaunay triangulation using Qhull.

joggled_input.description: Joggled input instead of merged facets
joggled_input.title: Joggled input flag

search_simplex.description: Search all points for the initial simplex
search_simplex.title: Search simplex flag

delaunay_visible.description: Print Delaunay region if visible from point n, -n if not
delaunay_visible.title: Delaunay region visibility

delaunay_regions.description: Print Delaunay regions that include point n, -n if not
delaunay_regions.title: Delaunay regions inclusion

verify.description: Verify result: structure, convexity, and in-circle test
verify.title: Verify result flag

facets_summary.description: Report summary when n or more facets created
facets_summary.title: Facets summary

input_file_option.description: Input data from file, no spaces or single quotes
input_file_option.title: Input option file

output_file_option.description: Output results to file, may be enclosed in single quotes
output_file_option.title: Output option file

trace_point.description: Turn on tracing when point n added to hull
trace_point.title: Trace point flag

trace_merge.description: Turn on tracing at merge n
trace_merge.title: Trace merge flag

trace_merge_width.description: Trace merge facets when width > n
trace_merge_width.title: Trace merge width flag

stop_point.description: Stop Qhull after adding point n, -n for before
stop_point.title: Stop at point flag

stop_cone_point.description: Stop Qhull after building cone for point n
stop_cone_point.title: Stop at cone point flag

centrum_radius.description: Radius of centrum (roundoff added). Merge facets if non-convex
centrum_radius.title: Centrum radius

max_angle_cosine.description: Cosine of maximum angle. Merge facets if cosine > n or non-convex
max_angle_cosine.title: Maximum angle cosine

perturb_factor.description: Randomly perturb computations by a factor of [1-n,1+n]
perturb_factor.title: Perturb factor

min_facet_width.description: Min facet width for outside point (before roundoff)
min_facet_width.title: Min facet width

vertices_incident.description: Vertices incident to each Delaunay region
vertices_incident.title: Vertices incident flag

mathematica.description: Mathematica output (2-d only, lifted to a paraboloid)
mathematica.title: Mathematica flag

off_format.description: OFF format (dim, points, and facets as a paraboloid)
off_format.title: OFF format flag
